mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.activity_id, s.capacity, s.reserved, s.sold, a.price, l.seat_rows, l.seats_per_row FROM interviewworks_ticket.session s JOIN interviewworks_ticket.activity a ON a.id = s.activity_id LEFT JOIN interviewworks_ticket.seat l ON l.activity_id = s.activity_id WHERE s.id = #{sessionId}

SELECT z.id, z.name, z.color, z.row_start AS "rowStart", z.row_end AS "rowEnd", z.price, (SELECT count(*) FROM interviewworks_ticket.session_seat ss WHERE ss.session_id = z.session_id AND ss.zone_id = z.id) AS capacity, (SELECT count(*) FROM interviewworks_ticket.session_seat ss WHERE ss.session_id = z.session_id AND ss.zone_id = z.id AND ss.status = 'AVAILABLE') AS available FROM interviewworks_ticket.session_zone z WHERE z.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY z.sort_order
SELECT id, name, price_percent AS "pricePercent", eligibility FROM interviewworks_ticket.session_ticket_type WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY sort_order
SELECT seat_id FROM interviewworks_ticket.session_seat WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY seat_id

SELECT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM interviewworks_ticket.session_seat WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status IN ('RESERVED', 'SOLD')) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM interviewworks_ticket.ticket WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status IN ('PENDING_PAYMENT', 'PAID'))) ::int
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interviewworks_ticket.session_sales_settings (session_id, max_tickets_per_member, version, seat_rows, seats_per_row) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{maxTicketsPerMember}, #{version}, #{seatRows}, #{seatsPerRow}) ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE SET max_tickets_per_member = EXCLUDED.max_tickets_per_member, version = EXCLUDED.version, seat_rows = EXCLUDED.seat_rows, seats_per_row = EXCLUDED.seats_per_row

INSERT INTO interviewworks_ticket.session_zone (id, session_id, name, color, row_start, row_end, price, sort_order) VALUES (#{id}, #{sessionId}, #{name}, #{color}, #{rowStart}, #{rowEnd}, #{price}, #{sortOrder})

INSERT INTO interviewworks_ticket.session_ticket_type (id, session_id, name, price_percent, eligibility, sort_order) VALUES (#{id}, #{sessionId}, #{name}, #{pricePercent}, #{eligibility}, #{sortOrder})
INSERT INTO interviewworks_ticket.session_seat (session_id, seat_id) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{seat}) ON CONFLICT (session_id, seat_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE interviewworks_ticket.session_seat SET zone_id = #{zoneId} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND seat_id IN #{seat}
mapper.select: SELECT z.id AS zone_id, z.name AS zone_name, z.price, t.id AS ticket_type_id, t.name AS ticket_type_name, t.price_percent FROM interviewworks_ticket.session_seat ss JOIN interviewworks_ticket.session_zone z ON z.session_id = ss.session_id AND z.id = ss.zone_id JOIN interviewworks_ticket.session_ticket_type t ON t.session_id = ss.session_id AND t.id = #{ticketTypeId} WHERE ss.session_id = #{sessionId} AND ss.seat_id = #{seat}
